verdict.rationale: Requesty documents gateway-side routing policies that switch models without client changes. Fallback Policies retry the next model in a chain on timeout, rate limit or error, which covers availability. Load Balancing distributes requests across models by defined weights, with sticky trace_id/user_id assignment, and Latency-Based Routing picks the fastest model from real-time performance data. Missing for 10: an explicit cost-based routing rule, capability- or task-based routing rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mid-task switching behavior.
